description: Suggest the doors and windows a plan's room graph needs, as data; nothing is applied. For a room with no path back, a building with no entrance, a bath reachable only through a bedroom, or a windowless bedroom, it returns ready-to-paste `door`/`window` statements with a rationale, for you to choose among and insert. Each names its wall by an authored id or a unique wall category, else by absolute `at (x, y)` coordinates. Door candidates avoid furniture in the door's approach; window candidates do not consider furniture.
name: suggest
title: Suggest topology fixes (advisory)
